items.title: 2 Stupid Dogs - Complete Season 1
items.description:
All 13 episodes of 2 Stupid Dogs from 1993. This is a show that aired in short segments on Cartoon Network/Boomerang and featured the voice of Brad Garrett.

I'm still searching for a complete season 2. So far I'm missing about half of the episodes.
